snippet.description:
Staying consistent with UPSC preparation is difficult when you don’t have a clear system to plan and track your daily routine.

The LevelUp Mentorship Program (LMP) solves this with a dedicated preparation tracker that helps you visualise your day, follow your schedule and stay accountable.

With the tracker, you can:

See your day-wise study plan clearly
Track completed and pending topics
Identify whether you are staying on schedule
Build accountability and consistency in your UPSC preparation
Get a clear picture of your preparation over time

Instead of wondering whether your preparation is on track, the tracker gives you a system to know.

This tracking and accountability system is available exclusively to LevelUp IAS Mentorship Program students.
